name: DecisionLab
description: Premium startup validation, investor readiness, venture analysis, benchmarking, reporting, investor matching, and pitch deck platform. Founders can submit startup ideas, generate detailed analyses, discover investors, assess risks, identify growth opportunities, benchmark performance, and create investor-ready pitch decks from a single workspace.
criticalRule: Every startup idea submitted through Start Now must automatically create a project, save it permanently, and immediately display it in the Portfolio/Dashboard. No analysis, report, investor match, score, or pitch deck may exist without being attached to a saved project.
